description: This file defines the LaunchDelegate class, which implements a JSON-RPC interface for managing application launch, termination, and status inspection within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes configuration structures, event handling, and method declarations for interacting with underlying application managers.

classes.name: LaunchDelegate
classes.description: Implements a plugin that provides JSON-RPC methods for launching, stopping, and querying application status, along with event notifications and configuration management.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration settings for the LaunchDelegate plugin, including enabled state, default delegate, and timeouts.

classes.name: Config::Timeouts
classes.description: Timeout durations for launch and stop operations.

classes.name: AppStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of an individual application, including last update time, current state, last error, and process ID.

methods.name: endpoint_getInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the plugin, such as name, version, and current state.

methods.name: endpoint_configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with provided parameters like enabled state, default delegate, and timeouts.

methods.name: endpoint_launch
methods.description: Requests launching an application with specified parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_stop
methods.description: Requests stopping an application identified by appId.

methods.name: endpoint_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of an application.

methods.name: event_launchrequested
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a launch request.

methods.name: event_launchcompleted
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a launch operation has completed.

methods.name: event_stoprequested
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a stop request.

methods.name: event_stopcompleted
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a stop operation has completed.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is enabled.

methods.name: DelegateLaunch
methods.description: Handles launching an application via delegate.

methods.name: DelegateStop
methods.description: Handles stopping an application via delegate.

methods.name: UpdateStateLocked
methods.description: Updates internal state in a thread-safe manner.
